spec.description: Forensic analysis of one Domibus performance-test Run. Select a Run ID, inspect canonical T0–T9 timing, then correlate it with host and Domibus-container resources. Resource panels use the dashboard time range; set it to the Run window during analysis.

spec.title: Run Result
spec.description: Canonical Run result. Failed, invalid and aborted Runs remain part of the evidence set.

spec.title: Integrity
spec.description: End-to-end integrity verdict for the selected Run.

spec.title: Delivery Duration T8−T0
spec.description: Primary performance duration: complete destination payload available (T8) minus test start (T0).

spec.title: Throughput
spec.description: Payload bytes divided by T8−T0.

spec.title: Payload Size
spec.description: Payload size for the selected Run.

spec.title: Direction
spec.description: Run direction, for example A12 or A21.

spec.title: Run Identity & Configuration
spec.description: Canonical identity labels for the selected Run. Detailed hashes, notes and large evidence references stay out of Prometheus labels.

spec.title: T0–T9 Event Timeline
spec.description: Recorded experiment timestamps and timing quality. Timestamp values are Unix seconds converted to milliseconds for Grafana display.

spec.title: Stage Durations
spec.description: Derived T-stage durations for the selected Run, such as T1_T0, T3_T1, T5_T4, T6_T5, T8_T7 and T9_T8.

spec.title: Timing Quality
spec.description: Count of T0–T9 timestamps by quality classification: DIRECT, LOG_DERIVED, METRIC_DERIVED, or CORRELATED/APPROXIMATED.

spec.title: Host CPU Utilization
spec.description: Resource metrics are shown for the dashboard time range. Set the dashboard time range to the selected Run's T0–T9 window when performing forensic analysis. T0–T9 vertical annotations will be added when the Run event annotation source is implemented.

spec.title: Host Memory Utilization
spec.description: Resource metrics are shown for the dashboard time range. Set the dashboard time range to the selected Run's T0–T9 window when performing forensic analysis. T0–T9 vertical annotations will be added when the Run event annotation source is implemented.

spec.title: Host Network Throughput
spec.description: Resource metrics are shown for the dashboard time range. Set the dashboard time range to the selected Run's T0–T9 window when performing forensic analysis. T0–T9 vertical annotations will be added when the Run event annotation source is implemented.

spec.title: Host Disk Throughput
spec.description: Resource metrics are shown for the dashboard time range. Set the dashboard time range to the selected Run's T0–T9 window when performing forensic analysis. T0–T9 vertical annotations will be added when the Run event annotation source is implemented.

spec.title: Domibus Container CPU
spec.description: CPU cores consumed by the Domibus containers. The current baseline has no Docker CPU cap; each AP host exposes 2 vCPUs. Resource metrics are shown for the dashboard time range. Set the dashboard time range to the selected Run's T0–T9 window when performing forensic analysis. T0–T9 vertical annotations will be added when the Run event annotation source is implemented.

spec.title: Domibus Container Memory
spec.description: Domibus container working-set memory. The current baseline has no Docker memory cap. Resource metrics are shown for the dashboard time range. Set the dashboard time range to the selected Run's T0–T9 window when performing forensic analysis. T0–T9 vertical annotations will be added when the Run event annotation source is implemented.

spec.title: Peak Host CPU
spec.description: Peak host CPU utilization per AP over the current dashboard time range.

spec.title: Peak Domibus CPU
spec.description: Peak Domibus container CPU cores consumed over the current dashboard time range.

spec.title: Peak Domibus Memory
spec.description: Peak Domibus working-set memory over the current dashboard time range.

spec.title: Peak Host Network
spec.description: Peak combined host RX+TX throughput per AP over the current dashboard time range.
